title: Read a trace on the public demo

blocks.content:
Welcome to the Grafana Labs learning path that teaches you to read a distributed trace, hands-on, on the public play.grafana.org demo.

A trace records the whole journey of one request as it moves through the services of a distributed system. Reading one tells you what each step did and where the request spent its time. That skill is the same wherever you open a trace, so learning it once carries everywhere.

## Here's what to expect

When you complete this path, you'll be able to:

- Open a real trace and take in the shape of its span waterfall at a glance
- Follow parent and child nesting to see which operation ran inside which
- Compare span durations to see where a request spent its time
- Read a service and operation name, and open a span for its attributes

## Before you begin

No account or setup needed. You're on the public play.grafana.org demo, which streams live traces you can open right now.

This path teaches trace **anatomy**: how to read any trace you open, whether it landed in your lap or you went looking for it. It doesn't teach the Traces Drilldown investigation workflow or how to write a query; those come later.
